content.text: {"class": "TEST_CODE_DEFECT", "reasoning": "The test harness cached a 900s token in a static field shared across parallel classes and reused it at age 1057s, so it sent an expired credential; the 401 TOKEN_EXPIRED is the product correctly rejecting an invalid request. Per the class rules, state the test carries between runs in the suite's own machinery (a static field) is TEST_CODE_DEFECT, not TEST_DATA, and the request was not valid so PRODUCT_DEFECT is excluded. History confirms the test side moved: AuthSupport was edited on 2026-09-17 to reuse tokens and the failure appeared when parallelism rose to 6 threads."}
